raceSandstoneTomb.name: Sandstone Tomb
raceSandstoneTomb.desc: The sand closes over them, and the sand remembers. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy and Roots them for 2 rounds.

raceHawk.name: Hawk
raceHawk.desc: Two fingers on the glove. At the end of every round it dives 6 tiles at the nearest enemy for 35; anything hidden within 2 tiles of it is spotted. Two hits to bring it down.

raceWolfPack.name: Wolf Pack
raceWolfPack.desc: Never one. At the end of every round each wolf runs 4 tiles at the nearest enemy and bites for 45. Two per handler. Calls a Wolf to an adjacent tile; two hits to put one down.

raceCrackTheWhip.name: Crack the Whip
raceCrackTheWhip.desc: The whip cracks — or the spirit roars — and they run. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy and Fears them for a round: on its next activation it can only flee.

raceElephant.name: Elephant
raceElephant.desc: The big top's biggest act. Walks 3, hits for 110, takes six hits to put down. One per handler. Calls an Elephant to an adjacent tile; at the end of every round it walks toward the nearest enemy and strikes.

raceDeathRoll.name: Death Roll
raceDeathRoll.desc: Clamp and spin. MEDIUM physical damage, and the prey is not going anywhere. Roots a Single Enemy for 2 rounds.

raceCocoon.name: Cocoon
raceCocoon.desc: The silk closes over the mouth first. HEAVY arcane damage; a Rooted target is wrapped tight and takes half again. Silences a Single Enemy for a round.

raceAnnihilation.name: Annihilation
raceAnnihilation.desc: Unmake it. Deals HEAVY magic damage to a Single Enemy and strips every buff they carry. Cooldown: 2 rounds.

raceSpiritGuide.name: Spirit Guide
raceSpiritGuide.desc: Take my hand. They cannot see what is not here. An ally is Invisible for a round and Levitating for 2 rounds.

raceShakeItOff.name: Shake It Off
raceShakeItOff.desc: Walk it off. Restores 25% of the caster's max HP and cleanses 2 debuffs. Cooldown: 2 rounds.

raceMaul.name: Maul
raceMaul.desc: Jaws lock and shake. MEDIUM physical damage and a wound that will not close. A Single Enemy takes a Grievous Wound for 2 rounds — healing on them is halved.

raceNeedleWork.name: Needle Work
raceNeedleWork.desc: Push the pin in. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy that ignores M DEF; a Voodoo-bound target takes it worse.

raceHemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
raceHemorrhage.desc: Open the vein. MEDIUM magic damage and a wound that will not close — healing on them is halved. The Grievous Wound lasts 2 rounds.

raceExsanguinate.name: Exsanguinate
raceExsanguinate.desc: Take all of it. HEAVY magic damage to a Single Enemy and every point of it comes back to you. Deals bonus damage to targets with a Grievous Wound.

raceConstrict.name: Constrict
raceConstrict.desc: Two arms, then four. It is not going anywhere. Roots a Single Enemy for 2 rounds and lowers its DEF by 1 stage.

raceEightfoldLash.name: Eightfold Lash
raceEightfoldLash.desc: All of them at once. Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy across 4 hits. Deals bonus damage to Rooted targets.

raceAcidFlask.name: Acid Flask
raceAcidFlask.desc: It eats the plate first. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy and lowers its DEF by 1 stage.

raceAntidote.name: Antidote
raceAntidote.desc: Drink it before it stops fizzing. Restores a BIG amount of HP to a Single Ally and cleanses 2 debuffs.

raceChainReaction.name: Chain Reaction
raceChainReaction.desc: One spark. The whole table goes. Deals HEAVY magic damage to every enemy in a 5×5 area. Deals bonus damage to targets with Burn or Poison.

raceMilkAndCookies.name: Milk and Cookies
raceMilkAndCookies.desc: Left out for whoever's still standing. Every ally within 2 tiles heals a MEDIUM amount of HP and is cleansed of 1 debuff.

raceSystemCrash.name: System Crash
raceSystemCrash.desc: Fatal exception. Deals HEAVY magic damage to every enemy in a 3×3 area. Deals bonus damage to targets with Jammed.

raceSlapLeather.name: Slap Leather
raceSlapLeather.desc: Hand hovers, then it doesn't. MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy — they flinch and lose an AP. Hits harder on anyone who already made their move.

raceEyewitness.name: Eyewitness
raceEyewitness.desc: They will describe it badly for the rest of their lives. Every enemy in a 3×3 within 4 tiles is Feared for a round and Blinded for 2 rounds.

raceOutOfTheDark.name: Out of the Dark
raceOutOfTheDark.desc: One clear look. That was the last photo on the roll. Charges up to 3 tiles and deals HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to Feared targets.

raceDoorSlam.name: Door Slam
raceDoorSlam.desc: Mind your fingers. Shoot a door onto a Single Enemy within 4 tiles and slam it on them for MEDIUM physical damage. Deals bonus damage to Staggered targets.

raceSpout.name: Spout
raceSpout.desc: A jet of seawater from the gills. WEAK water damage and the target is soaked through.

raceSurveillance.name: Surveillance
raceSurveillance.desc: We have had a file on you for years. A Single Enemy within 6 tiles is Marked for 2 rounds: they cannot hide, and the next physical hit any ally lands deals +40.

raceQuicksand.name: Quicksand
raceQuicksand.desc: The ground is fine until it is not. Turns a 3×3 to quicksand for 2 rounds: enemies inside are Rooted and Slowed.

raceSimoom.name: Simoom
raceSimoom.desc: The hot wind that kills. HEAVY magic damage to everything in the square, and nobody sees where it came from. Applies Blind to All Enemies in the 3×3.

raceEmberHeart.name: Ember Heart
raceEmberHeart.desc: The furnace inside never goes out. Restores 20% of the caster's max HP and gives them Regen for 2 rounds.

raceBrokenHalo.name: Broken Halo
raceBrokenHalo.desc: What is left of the halo, thrown like a discus. Deals MEDIUM magic damage and strips every buff the target carries; Burning targets take it worse.

raceCatNap.name: Cat Nap
raceCatNap.desc: Twenty minutes. Good as new. Restores 30% of the caster's max HP and removes every debuff.

raceCombust.name: Combust
raceCombust.desc: Feed the fire what it wants. MEDIUM magic damage — a Burning target goes up like tinder.

raceStrangeLoop.name: Strange Loop
raceStrangeLoop.desc: The pattern closes on itself. They cannot find the way out. Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy within 4 tiles and Stuns them for a round.

racePleiadianTouch.name: Pleiadian Touch
racePleiadianTouch.desc: A hand on the shoulder. The wound remembers being whole. Heals an ally a BIG amount and removes one debuff.

raceStackedDeck.name: Stacked Deck
raceStackedDeck.desc: You have been reading their tell all night. A Single Enemy within 4 tiles is Marked for 2 rounds (the next physical hit on them deals +40) and loses 1 DEF stage.

raceJackpot.name: Jackpot
raceJackpot.desc: The machine pays out. All of it. On their heads. Deals HEAVY magic damage to All Enemies in a 3×3 and Staggers them.

raceGiantStride.name: Giant Stride
raceGiantStride.desc: Four of your steps. One of his. Stride up to 4 tiles in a line; every enemy on the path takes WEAK physical damage.

raceBlueBeam.name: Blue Beam
raceBlueBeam.desc: Holograms in the sky. Half of them panic; the other half kneel. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to All Enemies in a 3×3 and applies Discord.

raceHornHook.name: Horn Hook
raceHornHook.desc: Hooked on the horns and dragged home. MEDIUM physical damage; they end the turn where the hooves are. Pulls the target 2 tiles toward the caster and Roots it.

raceSaddleUp.name: Saddle Up
raceSaddleUp.desc: Mount up. The caster is Overclocked for 2 rounds (+1 ATK stage, +1 MOV) and cleansed of up to 2 debuffs.

raceRideBy.name: Ride-By
raceRideBy.desc: Don't stop. Ride up to 4 tiles in a line: MEDIUM physical damage to the enemy at the end of the ride, and WEAK physical damage to every enemy passed.

raceLance.name: Lance
raceLance.desc: Couched and level. Charges a Single Enemy up to 5 tiles away and drives it up to 2 tiles along the line. Deals HEAVY physical damage; crashing into a wall or another unit deals 40 more.

raceSnare.name: Snare
raceSnare.desc: A loop of wire where the game walks. The first thing that steps in it is not going anywhere for 2 rounds. Hides a snare on an empty tile within 3; the enemy cannot see it. The first enemy to step on it takes WEAK physical damage and is Rooted for 2 rounds. Two snares per caster.

raceShatter.name: Shatter
raceShatter.desc: Tap the ice and watch it go. MEDIUM magic damage — a Frozen target takes it through every crack.

raceDoomscroll.name: Doomscroll
raceDoomscroll.desc: They read the comments. All of them. A Single Enemy within 4 tiles is Discorded for 2 rounds: ATK down 2 stages and DEF down 1.

raceRabbitHole.name: Rabbit Hole
raceRabbitHole.desc: Three hours later you are somewhere else entirely. Teleports the caster to an unoccupied tile within 3.

raceRatiod.name: Ratio'd
raceRatiod.desc: The whole internet piles on. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy and lowers their ATK by 1 stage. Deals bonus damage to targets with Discord.

raceSpiritBomb.name: Spirit Bomb
raceSpiritBomb.desc: Lend me your energy. Marks a 3×3 within 5 tiles; at the end of the round it lands for HEAVY magic damage to everything inside.

raceShieldBash.name: Shield Bash
raceShieldBash.desc: Edge of the shield, under the chin. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to an adjacent enemy and Staggers them: they lose 1 AP.

raceStaticShock.name: Static Shock
raceStaticShock.desc: A crack of static across the gap. MEDIUM magic damage, and the jolt costs them an action.

raceChainLightning.name: Chain Lightning
raceChainLightning.desc: It never wanted just one of you. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy, then jumps to up to 2 more enemies within 2 tiles of the last, weaker with each jump.

raceTempest.name: Tempest
raceTempest.desc: Call the sky down on the lot of them. HEAVY magic damage to a 3x3; everything in it is Stunned for a round and flyers are knocked out of the air.

raceRoundhouseKick.name: Roundhouse Kick
raceRoundhouseKick.desc: Everyone in reach. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to All Enemies in the 3×3 around you and Staggers each of them.

racePressurePoint.name: Pressure Point
racePressurePoint.desc: Two fingers. Lights out. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to an adjacent enemy and Stuns them for a round. Cooldown: 2 rounds.

raceFullBurst.name: Full Burst
raceFullBurst.desc: Every hardpoint on the frame, at once. Deals HEAVY physical damage to All Enemies in a 5×5 within 5 tiles. Fires through cover.

raceDeepBreath.name: Deep Breath
raceDeepBreath.desc: In through the nose. Restores a MEDIUM amount of HP to the caster and cleanses 1 debuff.

raceMantra.name: Mantra
raceMantra.desc: One word, everyone breathing it. Every ally within 2 tiles gains Regen for 3 rounds and is cleansed of 2 debuffs.

raceMirrorShard.name: Mirror Shard
raceMirrorShard.desc: A sliver of the glass. It finds the next face too. Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy, then bounces to another enemy within 2 tiles for half.

raceSevenYears.name: Seven Years
raceSevenYears.desc: You broke it. You know the rule. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy and Hexes them for 2 rounds.

raceShatteredMirror.name: Shattered Mirror
raceShatteredMirror.desc: Every shard, every eye. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to All Enemies in a 3×3 within 4 tiles and Blinds them for a round.

racePremonition.name: Premonition
racePremonition.desc: It saw the bridge go. It tells one of you to step back. A Single Ally within 4 tiles gains Protect for a round and +1 SPD stage.

raceHarbinger.name: Harbinger
raceHarbinger.desc: Everything in the square is on the list. Every enemy in a 3×3 within 4 tiles is Marked and Discorded for 2 rounds.

raceMiasma.name: Miasma
raceMiasma.desc: The air goes green. HEAVY magic damage to a 5x5, Poison on all of it. Deals bonus damage to targets with Poison.

raceCampaignPromise.name: Campaign Promise
raceCampaignPromise.desc: Look them in the eye and promise everything. A Single Enemy within 4 tiles is Charmed for a round.

raceDosed.name: Dosed
raceDosed.desc: Something in the drink. Their feet stop agreeing with them. Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy and Slows them for 2 rounds.

raceContactHigh.name: Contact High
raceContactHigh.desc: Everyone in the tent is on something. Every ally within 2 tiles gains +1 M ATK and +1 SPD stage.

raceTelekineticSlam.name: Telekinetic Slam
raceTelekineticSlam.desc: Grab them with your mind and drag them the whole way — through whatever is between you. Flyers come down first. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy and pulls it 3 tiles toward the caster.

raceHogtie.name: Hogtie
raceHogtie.desc: Hands and feet. Roots an adjacent enemy for 2 rounds and Staggers it for 1 round. No damage.

raceTimberStomp.name: Timber Stomp
raceTimberStomp.desc: One foot down. Everything adjacent staggers. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to All Enemies around the caster and applies Stagger.

raceScareOff.name: Scare Off
raceScareOff.desc: That is what it is for. Every enemy within 2 tiles is Feared for a round and shaken for two. Applies Feared (1 round) and Discord (2 rounds); no damage.

raceConsumingDark.name: Consuming Dark
raceConsumingDark.desc: The dark eats first what is already running. MEDIUM magic damage to a 3×3; Feared targets take it worse.

raceMeanMug.name: Mean Mug
raceMeanMug.desc: Stare them down until they look away. A Single Enemy within 3 tiles is Discorded for 2 rounds.

raceTendrilWhip.name: Tendril Whip
raceTendrilWhip.desc: The suit lashes out two tiles. The barbs stay in. Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy within 2 and Poisons it for 2 rounds.

raceEverybodyUp.name: Everybody Up
raceEverybodyUp.desc: On three. Every ally within 2 tiles gains +1 ATK and +1 DEF stage and is cleansed of every debuff.

raceStutter.name: Stutter
raceStutter.desc: They drop a frame. Staggers a Single Enemy for 1 round and Slows it for 1 round.

raceMisdirection.name: Misdirection
raceMisdirection.desc: Look — over there. Blinds a Single Enemy within 3 for 1 round: its attacks miss half the time.

raceSuckerPunch.name: Sucker Punch
raceSuckerPunch.desc: They never saw it coming. Literally. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to an adjacent enemy. Deals bonus damage to Blinded targets.

raceVivisection.name: Vivisection
raceVivisection.desc: For science. Hold still. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy within 2 and inflicts Grievous Wound for 2 rounds (healing halved).

raceClawSweep.name: Claw Sweep
raceClawSweep.desc: Both arms, every direction. MEDIUM physical damage to everything adjacent, and none of it heals right. Applies Grievous Wound for 2 rounds.

raceLunarRegeneration.name: Lunar Regeneration
raceLunarRegeneration.desc: The wounds close while you watch. Restores 25% of the caster's max HP, cleanses 1 debuff and gives Regen for 2 rounds.

raceGale.name: Gale
raceGale.desc: One long breath down the row. MEDIUM magic damage to everything in the line, and all of it three tiles further from you.

raceUpdraft.name: Updraft
raceUpdraft.desc: Give them the sky. One ally is Levitating for 2 rounds — flight and the high-ground bonus.

raceGlacialSlam.name: Glacial Slam
raceGlacialSlam.desc: Bring both fists down. MEDIUM physical damage to everything around you, all of it Slowed — and anything Frozen shatters.

raceEvilEye.name: Evil Eye
raceEvilEye.desc: One look is enough. Deals WEAK magic damage and Hexes the target for 2 rounds.

raceGrab.name: Grab
raceGrab.desc: The hands do not let go. Deals WEAK physical damage and Roots the target for a round.

raceRejuvenation.name: Rejuvenation
raceRejuvenation.desc: Everything green in you wakes up at once. Every ally within 3 tiles heals a MEDIUM amount of HP, is cleansed of 1 debuff and gains Regen for 2 rounds. Cooldown: 2 rounds.
